entries.title: A config in the wrong shape is a client that reports success and registers nothing
entries.summary: `jcodemunch-mcp init` went from 5 auto-configured clients to 10: **Codex CLI**, **opencode**, **Gemini CLI**, **Cline** and **VS Code / GitHub Copilot** join Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf and Continue.

entries.title: Half the tool descriptions never said what the tool would not do
entries.summary: Scored every description this server emits against the rubric in [arXiv:2602.14878](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.14878) (Hasan, Li, Rajbahadur, Adams & Hassan, Queen's University), which examined 856 tools across 103 MCP servers and found 97.1% carrying at least one description smell.
